title: Refresh architecture baseline
objective: Keep architecture.md and ArchEx outputs current so code structure and next steps stay grounded in reality
entry_criteria: The repo builds enough for ArchEx to analyze it
done_criteria: architecture.md, .archex/metrics.json, and .archex/graph.json reflect the current codebase
validation: ArchEx regenerate completes and outputs are reviewed

title: Validate single-leg kinematics and IK
objective: Prove one leg can reach commanded targets repeatably before broadening to full-body behavior
entry_criteria: Nominal geometry and a single-leg controller scenario are available
done_criteria: Single-leg controller hits targets within agreed tolerance in simulation
validation: Simulation run with target error acceptance bounds

title: Implement raise-to-nominal posture
objective: Move safely from motor zero to the working posture you want to operate from
entry_criteria: Motor-zero and nominal posture definitions both exist
done_criteria: Controller state machine can transition from q=[0,0,0] to nominal without unsafe transient motion
validation: Simulation scenario confirms bounded transition to nominal

title: Separate trajectory paths from time laws
objective: Make locomotion composable by cleanly separating spatial paths from temporal scheduling
entry_criteria: Current locomotion update path is understood and stable enough to refactor
done_criteria: Locomotion couples reusable path and time-law functions instead of hardcoding both inline
validation: Code review plus focused simulation check of the refactored gait path

title: Integrate full gait generation in simulation
objective: Produce stable per-leg targets and phase behavior across the whole robot in Webots
entry_criteria: Reusable locomotion, IK, and nominal posture pieces are available
done_criteria: A chosen world demonstrates stable commanded stepping behavior in simulation
validation: World-specific simulation evidence for nominal stance and motion

title: Connect operator input and motion states
objective: Let the console or joystick trigger posture transitions and teleop motion in a controlled state machine
entry_criteria: Input wrapper and gait controller entry points are available
done_criteria: Operator commands can raise to nominal and then drive movement through explicit states
validation: Input integration test confirms correct state transitions

title: Prepare hardware-facing bring-up
objective: Align the software stack with calibration, interface, and safety expectations needed for real hardware
entry_criteria: Simulation posture and motion control are stable enough to inform hardware integration
done_criteria: Bring-up sequence, interface assumptions, and validation gates are explicit
validation: Bring-up checklist and validation matrix are complete and reviewed
